# Chaliko Car Hire Limited

> Chaliko Car Hire Limited is a car rental company based in Lusaka, Zambia, operating a fleet of sedans, SUVs, 4x4s, and passenger vans across Lusaka, Ndola, Kitwe, Livingstone, Kabwe, and Chipata.

Vehicles are self-drive or chauffeur-driven, fully insured, and available for daily, weekly, and monthly hire. Bookings are made online or by phone/WhatsApp; a 30% deposit confirms a reservation.

## Company Background & Story

Chaliko Car Hire Limited was founded with one clear goal: *to make reliable and affordable vehicle rental accessible to every Zambian and visitor to our beautiful country.* Over the years, we have grown from a humble fleet into one of Zambia's most trusted car hire companies, serving clients across six major cities and beyond.

We serve individuals, families, corporate clients, NGOs, and tourists. We deliver tailored solutions for every need, whether it is a quick city commute or a cross-country safari adventure. Our team is dedicated to ensuring that every client drives away with confidence and peace of mind.

From our base in Lusaka, we operate across Ndola, Kitwe, Livingstone, Kabwe, and Chipata. Wherever your journey takes you in Zambia, Chaliko is with you every kilometer of the way.

## Our Mission & Values

- **Our Mission:** To provide safe, reliable, and affordable vehicle hire that empowers clients to travel with confidence across Zambia.
- **Our Vision:** To become Zambia's leading car hire company, renowned for exceptional service, vehicle quality, and customer care.
- **Integrity:** Transparent pricing, honest communication, no hidden charges, ever. We mean what we say and deliver what we promise.
- **Excellence:** We hold the highest standards for vehicle maintenance, cleanliness, and service at every touchpoint, from booking to drop-off.
- **Safety First:** Every vehicle is comprehensively insured and regularly serviced. Your safety is paramount, we never compromise on it.
- **Community:** As a proudly Zambian business, we are committed to the local economy and the communities we serve across every city we operate in.

## What Sets Us Apart
- **Recognised Service Quality:** Acknowledged by clients and peers alike for consistently outstanding service across all locations. Our reputation is built on results, not promises.
- **Thorough Vehicle Inspections:** Every vehicle undergoes a strict multi-point safety and mechanical inspection before it is handed over to you.
- **Flexible Rental Plans:** Whether you need a car for 48 hours or a full year, our packages adapt to your specific timeline and requirements.
- **Countrywide Support:** With a strong presence in Lusaka, Ndola, Kitwe, Livingstone, Kabwe, and Chipata, help is never far away if you need it.

No per-vehicle daily rates are published on the site; pricing is quoted directly on enquiry.

## Frequently asked questions

- **Do I need a credit card to book?** We accept mobile money (MTN/Airtel), bank transfer, cash at pick-up, and debit or credit cards. A 30% deposit is required to confirm your reservation.
- **What documents do I need to hire?** A valid driver's licence (Zambian or international), a national ID or passport, and funds for the security deposit. Minimum age is 23 years.
- **What is the minimum rental period?** Two days (48 hours). Weekly and monthly rates are available at a discount.
- **Is fuel included in the rental price?** No. Vehicles must be returned at the same fuel level they were given at pick-up. A fuel surcharge can be pre-paid at collection if preferred.
- **Can I drive to other countries?** Cross-border travel requires prior approval and an additional fee; inform Chaliko when booking if you plan to travel outside Zambia.
